purpose: Verify an authorized enrolled user is permitted to access the course workspace.
preconditions: Course exists; user is enrolled.
action_or_input: Authorized user requests course workspace details.
expected_result: Access is granted and course workspace details are returned.

purpose: Verify access to course workspace is prohibited for unenrolled users.
preconditions: Course exists; user is not enrolled in course.
action_or_input: Unenrolled user requests course workspace details.
expected_result: Access is denied or returns None.

purpose: Verify registered student can access course materials and home based on registration data.
preconditions: Student is registered in the course.
expected_result: Student is recognized as a member and granted access.

purpose: Verify unregistered student cannot access course workspace.
preconditions: User is student but not registered in course.
expected_result: Access is denied or returns None.

purpose: Verify Observer can read course details, published materials, and announcements.
preconditions: Observer is linked to course.
action_or_input: Observer requests course workspace, materials, and announcements.
expected_result: Course workspace, materials, and announcements are readable.

purpose: Verify Observer is prohibited from viewing individual student submissions or grades.
preconditions: Observer is linked to course; student submissions and grades exist.
action_or_input: Observer attempts to view student submission or grade.
expected_result: Access is denied or returns None, protecting student privacy.

purpose: Verify Observer is prohibited from performing write actions in course.
preconditions: Observer is linked to course.
action_or_input: Observer attempts to create course material or announcement.
expected_result: Write action is rejected with permission error.

purpose: Verify TA may view submissions and grade for assigned course.
preconditions: TA is assigned to course; submission exists.
action_or_input: TA views submissions list and grades a submission.
expected_result: TA can view submissions and record draft grade.

purpose: Verify TA is prohibited from creating or editing assignments and materials.
preconditions: TA is assigned to course.
action_or_input: TA attempts to create assignment or course material.
expected_result: Action is rejected with permission error.

purpose: Verify students and TAs can view published course materials.
preconditions: Material is in published status; student is enrolled.
expected_result: Published material is returned in the list.

purpose: Verify unpublished draft or future scheduled material is hidden from students.
preconditions: Material is in draft or unreleased scheduled status; student is enrolled.
expected_result: Unpublished material is omitted from student view.

purpose: Verify scheduled material remains unavailable before its release time.
preconditions: Material is scheduled with release time in future; student queries materials.
expected_result: Scheduled material is not visible.

purpose: Verify scheduled material transitions to published when release time is reached.
preconditions: Material is scheduled with release time in past.
action_or_input: Scheduled materials release task is triggered.
expected_result: Material status transitions to published.

purpose: Verify assigned faculty may post course announcements.
preconditions: Faculty is assigned to course.
expected_result: Announcement is successfully posted.

purpose: Verify TA may post course announcement where permitted by Faculty.
preconditions: TA is assigned to course with announcement permission.
action_or_input: Permitted TA attempts to post announcement.
expected_result: Announcement is posted by permitted TA.

purpose: Verify student is prohibited from posting course announcements.
preconditions: Student is enrolled in course.
expected_result: Posting attempt is rejected with permission error.

purpose: Verify posted announcement is timestamped and visible to enrolled course members.
preconditions: Announcement exists in course.
expected_result: Announcement is returned with valid created timestamp.

purpose: Verify assignment defining due date, instructions, submission type, and points can be published.
preconditions: Draft assignment has all required fields configured with future due date.
expected_result: Assignment transitions to published.

purpose: Verify assignment missing required configuration cannot be published.
preconditions: Draft assignment lacks required due date.
action_or_input: Faculty attempts to publish invalid assignment.
expected_result: Publication is rejected with validation rule error.

purpose: Verify newly created assignment remains in Draft state until published.
preconditions: Faculty creates assignment.
expected_result: Assignment status is Draft.

purpose: Verify published assignment configured with future release date is withheld from students.
preconditions: Assignment is published/scheduled with future release date.
expected_result: Assignment is not visible in student list.

purpose: Verify assignment is visible to students once release time arrives.
preconditions: Assignment release date is in the past.
action_or_input: Scheduled assignments release task runs and student lists assignments.
expected_result: Assignment transitions to published and is visible to student.

purpose: Verify student submission matching configured type is accepted.
preconditions: Assignment configured for text submission; student is enrolled.
expected_result: Submission is accepted and recorded.

purpose: Verify student submission with inconsistent type is rejected.
preconditions: Assignment configured for file submission; student is enrolled.
expected_result: Submission is rejected with validation error.

purpose: Verify on-time submission before due date is accepted with submitted status.
preconditions: Current time is before assignment due date.
expected_result: Submission status is submitted.

purpose: Verify submission after due date is tracked with late status when allowed.
preconditions: Due date has passed; allow_late is enabled.
expected_result: Submission is recorded with late status.

purpose: Verify student may view their own submission history and status.
preconditions: Student has submitted an assignment.
expected_result: Submission history for the student is returned.

purpose: Verify student is prohibited from viewing another student submission data.
preconditions: Student A submitted work; Student B queries Student A data.
action_or_input: Student B requests Student A submission history.
expected_result: Access is denied with permission error.

purpose: Verify faculty and TA can grade submissions and grader identity is attributed.
preconditions: Submission exists; grader is assigned TA.
action_or_input: TA grades submission with points and feedback.
expected_result: Grade is recorded with TA user ID attribution.

purpose: Verify student is prohibited from grading submissions.
preconditions: Submission exists; actor is student.
action_or_input: Student attempts to record a grade.
expected_result: Action is rejected with permission error.

purpose: Verify draft grade remains invisible to student.
preconditions: Grade exists in Draft status; student is enrolled.
expected_result: Grade is not exposed (returns None).

purpose: Verify released grade is visible to corresponding student.
preconditions: Grade exists in Released status; student is enrolled.
expected_result: Grade and score are returned.

purpose: Verify faculty can release draft grades to students.
preconditions: Draft grade exists; actor is faculty.
expected_result: Grades are transitioned to released status.

purpose: Verify TA grading does not release grades and TA cannot release grades.
preconditions: TA grades submission.
expected_result: Grade remains in Draft status.

purpose: Verify student has read-only access to released grade and no write access.
preconditions: Released grade exists.
action_or_input: Student views grade and attempts no write capability.
expected_result: Grade is displayed in read-only form; student cannot modify grade.

purpose: Verify changing a released grade creates an audit log record with actor and timestamp.
preconditions: Grade has been released.
action_or_input: Faculty updates score on released grade.
expected_result: Audit record is created recording actor and time.
